identificationModule.briefTitle: Safety and Pharmacokinetics Study of ODM-201 in Castrate Resistant Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Safety and Pharmacokinetics of ODM-201 in Patients With Castrate Resistant Prostate Cancer: Open, Non-randomised, Uncontrolled, Multicentre, Multiple Dose Escalation Study With a Randomised Phase II Expansion Component

collaborators.name: Endo USA Inc., a Keenova Therapeutics Company

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetics of ODM-201 in patients with castrate resistant prostate cancer.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1: Number of Participants Who Experienced Dose Limiting Toxicity (DLT)
primaryOutcomes.description: A DLT was any Grade 3 or more toxicity (by National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events \[NCI CTCAE version 4.03\]) excluding less than Grade 4 neutropenia or thrombocytopenia, hematological toxicity lasting less than 7 days, and nausea, vomiting, diarrhea controlled with antiemetic and/or anti-diarrheal treatment.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 28 days for each cohort

primaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1: Number of Dose Limiting Toxicities Used to Determine the Maximum Tolerated Dose
primaryOutcomes.description: The MTD is defined as dose level at which 2 or more out of 6 participants experience a dose limiting toxicity (DLT)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 28 days for each cohort

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1 and 2: Participants With Decline of at Least 50% in Prostate-specific Antigen (PSA) in Chemotherapy-naïve and CYP17i-naïve Group
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with greater than or equal to 50% decrease in serum PSA from baseline at 12 weeks in group of participants who were naïve to both chemotherapy and CYP17 inhibitor

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1 and 2: Participants With Decline of at Least 50% in Prostate-specific Antigen (PSA) in Post-chemotherapy and CYP17i-naïve Group
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with greater than or equal to 50% decrease in serum PSA from baseline at 12 weeks in group of participants previously treated with chemotherapy but not CYP17 inhibitor

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1 and 2: Participants With Decline of at Least 50% in Prostate-specific Antigen (PSA) in Post-CYP17i Group
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with greater than or equal to 50% decrease in serum PSA from baseline at 12 weeks in group of participants previously treated with CYP17 inhibitor

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1 and 2: Participants With RECIST Response in Soft Tissue in Chemotherapy-naïve and CYP17i-naïve Group
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with overall complete response (CR), partial response (PR) or stable (SD) soft tissue disease according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST 1.1) in chest, abdomen, and pelvic CT or MRI scans.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1 and 2: Participants With RECIST Response in Soft Tissue in Post-chemotherapy and CYP17i-naive Group
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with overall complete response (CR), partial response (PR) or stable (SD) soft tissue disease according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST 1.1) in chest, abdomen, and pelvic CT or MRI scans.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1 and 2: Participants With RECIST Responses in Soft Tissue in Post-CYP17i Group
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with overall complete response (CR), partial response (PR) or stable (SD) soft tissue disease according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST 1.1) in chest, abdomen, and pelvic CT or MRI scans.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1 and 2: Participants With Stable Bone Disease in Chemotherapy-naïve and CYP17i-naïve Group
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with stable bone disease (no change). Radiographic bone progression was defined by the appearance of two or more new lesions on bone scan

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1 and 2: Participants With Stable Bone Disease in Post-chemotherapy and CYP17i-naïve Group
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with stable bone disease (no change). Radiographic bone progression was defined by the appearance of two or more new lesions on bone scan

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1 and 2: Participants With Stable Bone Disease in Post-CYP17i Group
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with stable bone disease (no change). Radiographic bone progression was defined by the appearance of two or more new lesions on bone scan

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1: Area Under the Plasma-Concentration-time Curve (AUCt) of ODM-201 at Steady-state
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Day 8 predose 0 h and 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 4, 6 and 8 h postdose

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1: Maximum Plasma Concentration (Cmax) of ODM-201 at Steady-state
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Day 8 predose 0 h and 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 4, 6 and 8 h postdose

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1: Time to Reach the Maximum Observed Concentration (Tmax) of ODM-201 at Day 1

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Phase 1: Maximum Plasma Concentration (Cmax) of Major Metabolite ORM-15341 at Steady-state

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Written informed consent
* Histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of prostate
* Ongoing androgen deprivation therapy with a LHRH analogue or antagonist or bilateral orchiectomy
* Progressive metastatic disease
* Adequate bone marrow, hepatic, and renal function

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known metastases in the brain
* History of other malignancy within the previous 5 years
* Known gastrointestinal disease or procedure that affects the absorption
* Not able to swallow the study drug
